text: kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu bandho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato .pe. santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā .pe. santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu bandho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato . [168] santi ca kho bhikkhave
